    --interaction-name : interaction name (as it should appear in output files)

    --time-step : time interval between two snap shots (default value = 0.10000000000000001)
    --time-shift : time shift to add in the vectors name, if initial state for current run is not at t = 0 (default value = 0)

    --precision : convergence precision (default value = 1e-14)
    --iter-max : maximal number of iterations (default value = 100)
